{{Quote|These bat-winged shuttles were never as popular as the more versatile ''Lambda'' class, but Imperials such as Orson Krennic appreciated its stark, brutal design. The Delta folds its wings to reduce space requirements in hangars and on landing pads, and deploys them for greater stability during atmospheric flight.|The ''[[Galactic Explorer's Guide]]''|<ref name="Galactic Explorer's Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Delta''-class T-3c shuttle''', or simply the '''''Delta''-class shuttle''',<ref name="TVE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> was a type of [[shuttle]] used by the [[Galactic Empire]] around the [[time]] of the [[Battle of Yavin]]. [[Director]] [[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic]] owned [[ST-149|one such vessel]]. It had a starkly geometric [[hull]] shape and folding [[bat]]-like wings.<ref name="Krennic's Imperial Shuttle" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:DeltaClassT3cShuttle-CGSWG.png|thumb|left|150px|ST 149 in landing configuration]]
The ''Delta''-class T-3c shuttle was originally designed as a side project by [[Sienar Fleet Systems]] and was not intended for production. However, Director Orson Krennic saw the concept design of the [[transport]] and became fascinated by it, leading to Sienar's decision to produce the shuttle. The [[Starship|ship]] was optimized for stealth, with a [[Color|dark]], sloped hull and composite skin. The crew cabin was sparse, with simple crash seats and storage straps. The foldable lateral wings decreased the shuttle's footprint when on the ground. The wings contained [[HoloNet]] and [[Subspace transceiver|Subspace]] [[antenna]]e to maintain communications when in deep [[Realspace|space]]. [[Laser cannon]]s were attached to the bottom of the shuttle and on the tip of each of its three wings.<ref name="Rogue One Visual Guide" />

==History==
In [[13 BBY]]<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref>, Director Orson Krennic of the [[Imperial Military Department of Advanced Weapons Research]] traveled to the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]]<ref name="UVG">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> world of [[Lah'mu]] in a ''Delta-''class T-3c shuttle, [[ST-149]], upon the discovery that [[Galen Walton Erso]] was hiding out on the planet with the rest of [[Erso family|his family]]. Needing his work to complete construction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]] as part of [[Project Stardust]], he traveled to the planet with a [[Krennic's guard squadron|contingent]] of [[Death trooper]]s accompanying him. Krennic was successful in [[Capture of Galen Erso|capturing]] Galen Erso with the latter being forced on board ST-149 to return to the [[Galactic Empire]] to finish construction on the First Death Star.<ref name="Rogue One">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

Upon the revelation that a [[Bodhi Rook|pilot]] working at an [[Eadu Energy Conversion Laboratory|energy laboratory]] on [[Eadu]] had recently defected and potentially compromised Project Stardust, Krennic traveled to the planet with his shuttle to inspect the [[Kyber crystal research team]] to determine who was the leak. The team, lead by Galen Erso, was brought before the landing pad in front of ST-149 where the team stood in front of Krennic and his guard, flanked by [[stormtrooper]]s of the [[975th Battalion]]. Krennic demanded that whoever was the mole turn himself in and when no one stood up, he declared it a group effort and ordered his Death troopers to execute them all until Galen intervened at the last moment and revealed he was the one who leaked the details. The team would be gunned down regardless, however Galen was spared the death troopers' wrath as the facility was soon attacked by [[starfighter]]s of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who [[Mission to Eadu|attacked]] the facility. While the laboratory was destroyed, Krennic and his guard were able to depart on ST-149 and avoided being killed while Galen died from wounds he sustained during the rebel attack.<ref name="Rogue One" />

Having survived the attack on Eadu, Krennic used ST-149 to travel to [[Mustafar]] after being summoned there by [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] to explain the recent [[Destruction of Jedha City|destruction]] of [[Jedha City]] by the First Death Star. Krennic traveled and met the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] at his [[Fortress Vader|personal fortress]] hoping to ensure that he would be able to regain control of the Death Star from [[Wilhuff Tarkin]].<ref name="Rogue One" />

Following the meeting with Vader, ST-149 flew to the planet [[Scarif]] and landed at the [[Imperial Center of Military Research]] where he sought any and all recorded transmissions and dispatches made by the now late-Galen Erso as a means of preventing the [[Death Star plans]] from falling into Rebel hands. The shuttle stayed parked at the facility when it was [[Battle of Scarif|attacked]] by [[Rebel Alliance Special Forces]] unit [[Rogue One]] lead by [[Captain]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor]] and Galen's daughter [[Jyn Erso]] where the Death Star plans were stolen and sent to the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Rebel fleet]] before the Death Star arrived and destroyed the complex.<ref name="Rogue One" /> 

Following Krennic's failures, the T-3c fell out of favor.<ref name="Dawn VG">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> [[Magna Tolvan]] chased down [[Chelli Lona Aphra|Chelli Aphra]] to [[Skako Minor]] in a ''Delta''-class T-3c shuttle.<ref name="Aphra 16">[[Doctor Aphra (2016) 16|''Doctor Aphra'' (2016) 16]]</ref> When [[Darth Sidious|Emperor Palpatine]] arrived at the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star II]] in his [[Emperor's personal shuttle|personal]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle]], [[TK-293]], one of the [[stormtrooper]]s present, declared that if he were Emperor, he'd show up in a ''Delta''-class T-3c shuttle.<ref name="Trooper Trouble">{{StoryCite|story=Trooper Trouble|book=From a Certain Point of View: Return of the Jedi}}</ref>
